requirements.requirement: Approach full-body lateral position relative to directed centerline before junction entry
requirements.source: NRS 484B.400(2)(a); The approach for a left turn must be made in that portion of the right half of the highway nearest the centerline thereof.

requirements.requirement: Both intersecting highways two-directional and public intersection context
requirements.source: Construct both highways as undivided and permitting opposite-direction travel; establish public dedication, public vehicular access and a non-alley intersection.
